idea: Moye: a Duolingo-style adaptive learning app for neurodivergent (ADHD, dyslexia) and neurotypical kids. Mascot Moyin the honey badger. Free stack: Supabase, PWA, browser speech.

wedge.title: Moye
wedge.sector: EdTech · adaptive learning for ADHD and neurotypical kids
wedge.target_user: Kids 6-12 who lose focus or feel shame in timed, streak-punishing learning apps; plus the parent/teacher who has to explain progress
wedge.painful_moment: A child with ADHD loses a streak, gets a buzzer sound and a sad mascot, and quits; the teacher has no plain-language view of where they struggle.
wedge.unusual_constraint: Calm by design: no timers, no guilt, daily cap with a done-for-today screen, all voice and AI offline-capable at zero API cost
wedge.proof_metric: TARGET (unmeasured): mastery model moves a learner to the right difficulty within 8 questions on committed fixtures

adversarial_critique.why_generic_risk: Nothing similar in our startup data; show one real user's problem in the first ten seconds.
adversarial_critique.obvious_competitor: Doing it by hand: spreadsheets, calls and WhatsApp.
adversarial_critique.unprovable_claim_risk: Claiming results beyond the committed test cases; report only what the fixtures measure.
adversarial_critique.hour_8_kill_criterion: By hour 8 one full Focus Mode lesson runs end to end with adaptive difficulty, honey reward and done-for-today screen.

reasons: proof 0 (no similar launched product in our startup data)
global +2 (no direct competitor in our data)
angles: Voice and text in Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo and Pidgin, for users who do not read English well
Works offline on a low-cost Android phone and syncs when the network returns
An agent that finishes the task end to end, not a chat box that suggests

features.feature: Spark streaks with freezes and rest-day tokens, no guilt copy
Focus Mode: one question at a time, progress bar not timer, Moyin body-double animation
Adaptive difficulty via Bayesian knowledge tracing per skill, no AI call
Honey economy: variable rewards, cosmetics for Moyin's hive, daily cap, done-for-today screen
Interest themes (dinosaurs, football) re-skin the same questions
